        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# --- Configuración general del gráfico ---\n",
        "plt.figure(\n",

        "\n",
        "# --- Gráfico de dispersión ---\n",
        "plt.scatter(\n",

        "    color='blue',     # color de los puntos\n",
        "    edgecolor='black',    # borde de los puntos\n",
        "    alpha=0.9 ,           # transparencia\n",
        "    s=50,                 # tamaño de los puntos\n",
        "    label='Promedio_Final' # etiqueta para la leyenda\n",

        "\n",
        "# --- Título ---\n",
        "plt.title(\n",

        "    fontsize=14,\n",

        ")\n",
        "\n",

        "\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from scipy.stats import pearsonr\n",
        "\n",
        "# Test de Pearson\n",
        "# H0: rho = 0     (No hay correlación)\n",
        "# H1: rho ≠ 0     (Sí hay correlación)\n",
        "# alpha = 0.05\n",
        "\n",
        "r, valor_p = pearsonr(x, y)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"Coeficiente de correlación: {r: 0.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f'Valor p: {valor_p: 0.4f}')\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "O3Lqa3dJjKCS",
        "outputId": "2c2440a7-2fe3-4c2a-c56b-aaeef841cef1"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Coeficiente de correlación:  0.7653\n",
            "Valor p:  0.0162\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
        "x_constante = sm.add_constant(x)\n",
        "modelo = sm.OLS(y, x_constante).fit()\n",
        "y_calculada = modelo.predict(x_constante)\n",
        "# es para sacar la formula y= 2.188(calorias quemadas cuando la ruracion es cero) + 729.983x(calorias quemadas por hora/duracion)\n",
        "modelo.params"
      ],

        "from scipy.stats import shapiro\n",

        "import seaborn as sns\n",

      "source": [
        "# Test de Breusch-Pagan\n",
        "# H0: No hay heterocedasticidad (dispersión es igual en toda la recta)\n",
        "# H1: Hay Heterocedasticidad (dispersión distinta a lo largo de la recta)\n",
        "# alpha = 0.05\n",
        "\n",
        "from statsmodels.stats.api import het_breuschpagan\n",
        "_, valor_p_bp, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(residuos, x_constante)\n",
        "print(f'valor_p de Breusch-Pagan: {valor_p_bp: 0.4f}\\n')"
      ],
      "metadata": {

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
        "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
        "\n",
        "# test de ANOVA (Analysis of Variance)\n",
        "# H0: beta_1 = 0   (No hay correlación)\n",
        "# H1: beta_1 ≠ 0   (Sí hay correlación)\n",
        "\n",
        "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
        "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
        "# Y~X\n",
        "modelo_lineal = ols('calorias_quemadas ~ duracion', data = df).fit()\n",
        "tabla_anova = sm.stats.anova_lm(modelo_lineal)\n",
        "tabla_anova"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from scipy.stats import pearsonr\n",
        "\n",
        "# Test de Pearson\n",
        "# H0: rho = 0     (No hay correlación)\n",
        "# H1: rho ≠ 0     (Sí hay correlación)\n",
        "# alpha = 0.05\n",
        "\n",
        "r, valor_p = pearsonr(x, y)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"Coeficiente de correlación: {r: 0.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f'Valor p: {valor_p: 0.4f}')\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "outputId": "28cd02a6-7934-4078-a6f8-fa608cc3dbd6",
        "id": "jvUR9EodoXMR"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Coeficiente de correlación:  0.7616\n",
            "Valor p:  0.0065\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
        "x_constante = sm.add_constant(x)\n",
        "modelo = sm.OLS(y, x_constante).fit()\n",
        "y_calculada = modelo.predict(x_constante)\n",
        "# es para sacar la formula y= 2.188(calorias quemadas cuando la ruracion es cero) + 729.983x(calorias quemadas por hora/duracion)\n",
        "modelo.params"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {

        },

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from scipy.stats import shapiro\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "residuos = modelo.resid\n",
        "\n",
        "# Prueba de Shapiro-Wilk\n",
        "stat, valor_p_sh = shapiro(residuos)\n",
        "print(f\"valor-p (Shapiro) = {valor_p_sh}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Visualización: Q-Q plot\n",
        "sm.qqplot(residuos, line='s')\n",
        "plt.title(\"Q-Q plot de residuos\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Histograma\n",
        "sns.histplot(residuos, kde=True)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Histograma de residuos\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n"
      ],

        "\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Test de Breusch-Pagan\n",
        "# H0: No hay heterocedasticidad (dispersión es igual en toda la recta)\n",
        "# H1: Hay Heterocedasticidad (dispersión distinta a lo largo de la recta)\n",
        "# alpha = 0.05\n",
        "\n",
        "from statsmodels.stats.api import het_breuschpagan\n",
        "_, valor_p_bp, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(residuos, x_constante)\n",
        "print(f'valor_p de Breusch-Pagan: {valor_p_bp: 0.4f}\\n')"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
        "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
        "\n",
        "# test de ANOVA (Analysis of Variance)\n",
        "# H0: beta_1 = 0   (No hay correlación)\n",
        "# H1: beta_1 ≠ 0   (Sí hay correlación)\n",
        "\n",
        "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
        "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
        "# Y~X\n",
        "modelo_lineal = ols('calorias_quemadas ~ duracion', data = df).fit()\n",
        "tabla_anova = sm.stats.anova_lm(modelo_lineal)\n",
        "tabla_anova"
      ],
